description: We are a team of young, brilliant minds who love science and technology. We bring a wealth of talent and skills to the NASA Space Apps Challenge that can help improve concept-building games for Space.
summary: We made a Space mission game App that challenges players to complete space exploration tasks while working as a team, and exploring through different missions. We developed a three mission concept: Space Station Repair, Searching for Life Signatures on Another Planet, and Collecting Samples for Rocket Fuel. Each Space mission involves us to plan objectives, assign astronaut roles, estimate budgets, selecting suitable spacecraft, managing communications, and considering challenges such as gravity, oxygen, food, mental health, and power. This game also addresses the challenges of space exploration on how teamwork, problem-solving, resource management, and careful planning are essential for completing the mission successfully.
details:
What does the BEYOND THE ORBIT game do? Our game helps astronauts to complete three different missions and helps them gain insight on how to survive in space.

How does it work? It allows you to play two different simulations (1 & 2) and see the output of your decisions live as different scenarios unfold.

What benefits does it have? It allows the players to see how stressful decisions astronauts have to make while in space. The astronauts have to use their ingenuity and skill to develop problem-solving skills and use the resources to complete the missions.

What is the intended impact of the project? The intended impact of the project is to develop a sense of motivation and excitement to see how and what resources to use in order to complete the mission successfully. To educate and inspire the players to understand how to use the resources to complete the challenge.

What tools, coding language, hardware, or software did we use to develop our project? We used our skills, talents, thoughts, teamwork, and communication skills to develop the project. It was written in HTML using Code HS's software and was launched as a website using Netlify.

How is our project creative? Our project is creative because it demonstrates how we were able to create a game that is realistic and helps players to make important decisions if they were actually in space and needing to use the resources.

What factors did our team consider? Our team had to establish responsibility and strategy to see how to properly use the resources to avoid the astronauts being in danger or to help them survive their mission successfully. We had to choose between the astronauts' comfort and continuing the mission, or both.
